description: Transcribe speech from an audio file URL (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, webm; up to 20 MB) into text with timestamps, in 90+ languages with automatic language detection. Can also translate the speech into English. Good for podcasts, calls, voice notes and meetings. Pay per call; ask the pricing tool for a quote.

language.description: Spoken language code if known, e.g. "en", "es". Detected automatically otherwise.

translate_to_english.description: Translate the speech into English instead of transcribing it as spoken.

url.description: Public URL of the audio file.

name: transcribe_audio
title: Speech to text (transcribe audio)
